scope: RAW_EXPLICIT_BOOLEAN_RELATION_INPUT; SEALED V3_2 GUARDED ELIMINATION RETURNS OPEN_BUCKET_PRODUCT_BUDGET ON ITS FIRST CANONICAL ELIMINATION BUCKET BEFORE ANY SUCCESSFUL BUCKET EXPANSION; FAILED BUCKET FACTORS ARE ORIGINAL EXPLICIT RELATIONS; NO ALTERNATIVE ORDER SEARCH.

formal_mechanism.failed_bucket: Let F_1,...,F_t be exactly the current factors in the first failed canonical bucket and x the failed variable.
formal_mechanism.common_core: C = intersection_i scope(F_i). Since all bucket factors contain x, x is in C.
formal_mechanism.core_support: For each factor compute P_i = pi_C(F_i) by scanning explicit rows; compute S = intersection_i P_i without any Cartesian product.
formal_mechanism.empty_case: If S is empty, conjunction_i F_i is unsatisfiable, hence the whole instance is exactly UNSAT. Return EXACT_UNSAT_BY_EMPTY_COMMON_CORE_SUPPORT_INTERSECTION.
formal_mechanism.semijoin_case: If S is nonempty, replace every failed-bucket factor F_i by the subset of its original rows whose C-projection is in S. Preserve every non-C variable and every original tuple coordinate; do not project away payload/external variables.
formal_mechanism.handoff: Run the already sealed v3.2 guarded elimination on the semijoin-filtered raw instance in the same canonical order. If it admits, replay its witness against the ORIGINAL unfiltered explicit relations and return ADMIT_EXACT_COMMON_CORE_SEMIJOIN_THEN_GUARDED_ELIMINATION. If it remains OPEN_BUCKET_PRODUCT_BUDGET, return OPEN_COMMON_CORE_FILTERED_BUCKET_STILL_OVER_L2.
formal_mechanism.exactness: Any satisfying assignment to the original bucket induces one common-core state in every P_i and therefore in S; rows removed by the semijoin cannot participate in any satisfying bucket assignment. Filtering only removes impossible rows and adds none. Empty S is an exact contradiction certificate.
formal_mechanism.resource: Projection, support intersection and semijoin filtering are linear/polynomial in explicit tuple cells and never enumerate the raw bucket Cartesian product. The handoff inherits the frozen v3.2 L^2 pre-expansion guard and O(L^6) conservative lifecycle. Filtering never increases explicit input size, so one original-L fixed polynomial envelope remains sufficient.

positive_control.construction: Same v3.2 overbudget topology and row-count pattern, but every added Y-plus-local factor contains exactly one shared Y witness X plus decoy Y states; the three base left factors already intersect on X. Raw product remains over L^2, common-core intersection is {X}, semijoin reduces each bucket factor to its X-compatible rows, and frozen guarded elimination must admit with original-row witness replay.

negative_controls.construction: Use the same common Y witness in every factor but give each added factor multiple rows with that same Y state and distinct factor-local payload assignments so semijoin cannot reduce the row-count product below L^2.
